description: Election Commission - Appointed Chairman & Vice Chairman of  Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the appointment of the Chairman and Vice Chairman of the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha following a local authority election. It is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and issued by the Election Commission. The content specifically deals with election results and declarations for a local government body, which falls under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
